# Navego

Drive your own signed-in browser from an MCP client — no cloud hop, no exported session, one npm install.

Site: https://navego.pages.dev/
Source: https://github.com/afnannuzulasugihartono/navego
Package: `navego` on npm. License: MIT.

## One command to try

```bash
npm i -g navego
navego doctor --json   # one object: bridge, device, plan, quota — the fix when degraded
```

From any MCP client:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "navego": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "navego"] }
  }
}
```

## What it does

- 45 `browser_*` / `artifact_*` / `delivery_*` / `wallet_*` tools over a loopback bridge.
- Reads pages, clicks, types, navigates, downloads artifacts; your own everyday browser, not a sandboxed one.
- 36 allowlisted browser primitives, no free `eval`, no per-site gadgets.
- Structured output: `navego doctor --json` answers with `{ ready, port, bridge, problems[], crxUrl }`.
- Metered by plan; a request past the allowance answers `PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED` naming the plan.

## What it does not do

- Does not send browsing traffic to a remote browser or cloud driver.
- Does not bypass paywalls, captchas, sign-in walls, or rate limits.
- Does not run per-site code or free `eval` in the browser.

## Docs for agents

- llms.txt and per-client snippets: https://github.com/afnannuzulasugihartono/navego/blob/main/llms.txt and https://github.com/afnannuzulasugihartono/navego/blob/main/docs/agent-friendly.md
- Install guide written for agents: https://github.com/afnannuzulasugihartono/navego/blob/main/llms-install.md
- Product docs: https://navego.pages.dev/docs
- MCP page: https://navego.pages.dev/mcp

## Ground rules for agents

- Claim a tab before driving it; never touch `chrome://`, password fields, or payment dialogs.
- Read the page before acting on it; `browser_get_guide` is the right first call.
- `PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED` means stop and tell the person, not retry.
